reason: Preserve native installation portability; owner directive 2026-11-03 (ADR0023) removes inherited PR approval/CI workflows and time-cap recipes in favor of native ship-loop and watchdog.

edits.before: - No `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` means `/setup-pstack` hasn't run for this user, so every role uses its default model.
edits.after: - Inspect the destination harness's native role configuration through **setup-mistystack**; absence of a Cursor rule says nothing about native setup.

edits.before: 1. Install with `/add-plugin pstack` in chat, or from Customize in the sidebar.
edits.after: 1. Install Mistystack through the destination harness's native lifecycle in the pstack names adapter; the full pstack foundation is bundled.

edits.before: 2. Run [`/setup-pstack`](../setup-pstack/SKILL.md). It asks for a reasoning budget, maps a model to each role, and writes a rule. The rule applies to new chats. Then it offers once each to generate a verification skill and a formal verification skill for the project, unless the project already has one.
edits.after: 2. Run [`/setup-pstack`](../setup-pstack/SKILL.md). It uses **setup-mistystack** for native model and reasoning configuration, then offers verification and formal-verification skills when the project has none.

edits.before:
pstack is built for Cursor, and it also installs in Claude Code with `/plugin marketplace add cursor/plugins`, then `/plugin install pstack@cursor-plugins`. There, each command takes a `pstack:` prefix, such as `/pstack:poteto-mode`. The [Claude Code adapter](../../docs/harness/claude-code.md) maps the Cursor names, and a step that needs a Cursor-only feature, such as Bugbot or Automations, is skipped with a one-line note.

Other tools can read the skills, because they use the Agent Skills format. But most workflow skills, including `/poteto-mode`, `/how`, `/why`, and `/teach`, spawn Cursor subagents with per-role models, and Custom Modes and `/loop` are Cursor features, so those parts may not work there.
edits.after: Mistystack installs this foundation in OMP, Claude Code, Codex and pi. Use the pstack names adapter for native invocation, subagents, models, history and event handling. A missing integration never skips required proof or independent judgment.

edits.before:
- Option+Enter on Mac or Alt+Enter on Windows, or Use as Mode from the skill entry, makes it a Custom Mode. It stays in context every turn until the user exits the mode, and it stays out of casual turns.
- Cursor's docs list Custom Modes in the Agents Window and the CLI. Elsewhere, start each new task with `/poteto-mode`.
edits.after: - Custom Mode keyboard shortcuts are Cursor-only. In OMP, Claude Code, Codex and pi, invoke the installed skill explicitly at the start of each new task through the native skill mechanism in the pstack names adapter.

edits.before: | Strip comments before review, using a reviewer that didn't write them | [`/no-comments`](../no-comments/SKILL.md) |
edits.after: | Audit a requested comment-only scope | [`/no-comments`](../no-comments/SKILL.md) |

edits.before: - "babysit this pr" or "check on pr 123" runs Babysit. It drives the PR to merge-ready and stops there. It doesn't merge unless the user asks to merge, land, or ship.
edits.after: - "check on pr 123" inspects and reports its current state. It does not start an approval loop.

edits.before: - "land the stack" runs Shipping.
edits.after: - Delivery requests use the installed [ship-loop](../ship-loop/SKILL.md) skill for author-run proof, merge and the post-merge release gate.

edits.before: - "full autopilot on this queue" runs Autopilot-full. "autopilot, don't merge" runs Autopilot-stack.
edits.after: - An independent queue uses one author per slice under ship-loop. Carry forward an explicit no-merge hold without inventing an approval gate for other work.

edits.before: Without `/poteto-mode`, a phrase such as "babysit this pr" can start Cursor's own skill for the same job instead. The Playbooks section of [`poteto-mode`](../poteto-mode/SKILL.md) lists every playbook and when it applies. [Guide page 6](../../docs/guide/06-verify-and-ship.md) covers opening, babysitting, and landing a PR.
edits.after: The Playbooks section of [`poteto-mode`](../poteto-mode/SKILL.md) lists the retained task methods. The installed [ship-loop](../ship-loop/SKILL.md) skill is the single delivery authority; [the delivery guide](../../docs/guide/05-verify-and-ship.md) explains the delivery path.

edits.after: ## Inspect and deliver

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode we need <feature>. /architect it first, and answer open questions with prototypes. let me review before proceeding.`
edits.after: - `/poteto-mode we need <feature>. settle the design from prototype evidence, then implement the smallest shape that meets the goal.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode open the pr. small ordered commits, evidence in the description.`
edits.after: - `/ship-loop deliver <confirmed scope>. prove the changed journey on the running app and retain the evidence.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode babysit this pr. get it green.` For status only: `/poteto-mode check on pr <number>. anything outstanding?`
edits.after: - `/poteto-mode check on pr <number>. report its observed state and any concrete failure, without starting an approval loop.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode land the stack.`
edits.after: - `/ship-loop finish this queue through merge, the release gate and the live journey check.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode im going to bed. <goal> in a fresh worktree off <base>. done means <checks>. keep a decision log. don't ask me before committing. /loop until done. if you're truly stuck after a few hours, stop and write up why.`
edits.after: - `/poteto-mode im going to bed. <goal> in a fresh worktree off <base>. done means <checks>. keep a decision trail and use the watchdog until done. if a prerequisite is unreachable, preserve evidence, name it exactly and finish the unblocked work.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode full autopilot on this queue. each item is independent.`
edits.after: - `/ship-loop deliver this queue. each slice is independent and keeps one author through real-app proof, merge and release.`

edits.before: - `/poteto-mode autopilot these changes, but don't merge. i'll land them.`
edits.after: - `/poteto-mode build and prove these changes, but stop before merge. this is an explicit hold; i will land them.`

edits.before: - The real constraints. "repro first", "don't change any code yet", "zero behavior change", and "let me review before proceeding" each change what the agent does.
edits.after: - The real constraints. "repro first", "don't change any code yet" and "zero behavior change" each change what the agent does. State an owner hold only when it is actually required.

edits.before: - Give an exit: "if you're truly stuck after a few hours, stop and write up why".
edits.after: - Keep work open-ended under the installed [watchdog](../../watchdog/SKILL.md). Name an unreachable prerequisite exactly, preserve recovery evidence and finish every unblocked part instead of stopping at an elapsed-time limit.
